description_en: Creates an intelligent alert event recording plan
description_zh: 调用该接口创建智能告警事件录像计划
kebab_example: aliyun linkvisual create-event-record-plan --name plan1 --event-types 1 --pre-record-duration 5 --record-duration 10 --template-id fc82774fa749485bad7d719f96700000 --api-version 2018-01-20 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateEventRecordPlan

parameters.help_en:
The name of the recording plan.

The name must be fewer than 48 characters in length and can contain letters, digits, and the following special characters: hyphens (-), underscores (_), at signs (@), periods (.), and colons (:)
parameters.help_zh:
录像计划名称。

名称长度小于48个字符，可以包含英文字母、数字和特殊字符：短划线（-）、下划线（_）、at（@）、英文句号（.）、英文冒号（:）
parameters.name: name

parameters.help_en:
The intelligent alert event type.

To specify all intelligent alert event types, set this parameter to 0.
To specify multiple intelligent alert event types, enter the serial numbers of the events separated by commas (,). Example: `10001,10002`.
You can specify up to 10 intelligent alert event types at a time.

In the Chinese edition of the China IoT Platform console, view all intelligent alert event types on the Feature Definition tab of the Product Details page. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/207701.html
parameters.help_zh:
智能告警事件类型：

设置为全部智能告警事件：0。
设置为多个智能告警事件：输入智能告警事件对应的序号，并用英文逗号（,）分隔，例如：`10001,10002`。
设置多个智能告警事件时，单次最多支持设置10个。

请在物联网平台控制台，产品详情页面的功能定义页签，查看全部智能告警事件类型。详细信息，请参考https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/207701.html
parameters.name: event_types

parameters.help_en: The pre-recording duration. Unit: seconds. Default value: 0. Maximum value: 10
parameters.help_zh: 预录时长，单位为秒，默认值为0，最大值为10
parameters.name: pre_record_duration

parameters.help_en: The recording duration, including the pre-recording duration. Unit: seconds. Valid values: 10 to 60
parameters.help_zh: 录像时长，单位为秒，包括预录时长，取值范围10~60
parameters.name: record_duration

parameters.help_en: The ID of the time template. You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/107890.html to query the ID
parameters.name: template_id
